issues.explanation: New notifier, audit channel and config changes ship with no Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating the no-production-code-without-a-test rule.
No CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased despite conventions requiring docs kept in sync.

conventions.evidence: Follows logging separation and sibling style (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:38-39 uses Http/Log facades; config/logging.php:187 stack daily; docs/ops/logging-and-alerts.md:251-252 Discord is never a channel) but ships no tests, violating conventions.md TDD/no production code without a test and Pest coverage rules.

readability.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:43 renderValue/redactValue/isSensitiveKey/scrub are small, well-named; docs/ops/logging-and-alerts.md:31-35 table is clear; no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:43 send(title,message,context=[]); :48-50 null/empty no-op; :65-67 Http::timeout(5)->post(url, {'content':content}); :52-62 title/message/key=value join plus mb_substr 0,1800; :90-167 sensitive-key/Bearer/recursive-JSON redaction; :69-84 soft-fail error logs without URL plus scrub(:169-176); config/services.php:214-216 discord.webhook_url; config/logging.php:187 stack default daily, :195-201 audit daily/audit.log/info/90; .env.example:10,13-15,26 LOG_STACK/LOG_DAILY_DAYS/LOG_AUDIT_LEVEL/LOG_AUDIT_DAYS/DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL; phpunit.xml:317 LOG_STACK=daily; docs/ops/logging-and-alerts.md:27-64 lanes and decision guide; no discord channel added.

scope.evidence: All hunks serve the task: .env.example env keys, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php notifier, config/logging.php stack+audit, config/services.php discord key, docs/ops/logging-and-alerts.md guide, phpunit.xml pin; no unrelated refactors.

security.evidence: Checked app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:90-167 key/Bearer/recursive redaction, :70-77 non-2xx logs only status and transport error is scrubbed (:169-176 str_replace webhookUrl), outer try/catch never throws; no auth/validation surface, no mass-assignment or unescaped output.

simplicity.evidence: Minimal explicit code reusing config/Http/Log (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:46,65,70); no new abstractions, no duplication; audit/stack config is 8 lines (config/logging.php:195-201).

tests.evidence: No test files or test hunks appear anywhere in change.diff; new DiscordOpsAlert redaction/truncation/soft-fail paths and audit channel have zero Pest/PHPUnit coverage.

review.summary: Adds DiscordOpsAlert with correct redaction, truncation and soft-fail plus audit/daily/stack logging config, docs and env keys. Implementation meets the task contract, but it ships with no tests as required by project conventions, so it needs changes before merging.
